title: Neural Non-Equilibrium Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for Corrected Boltzmann Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2607.15682v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sampling from an unnormalized Boltzmann density requires proposals that move probability mass globally while retaining enough path-probability information for statistical correction. We introduce Neural Non-Equilibrium Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (NHMC), a train-then-correct learned Hamiltonian sampler. Starting from a tractable base distribution, NHMC learns stochastic Hamiltonian-style paths toward the target. Once training is complete, the learned proposal parameters are fixed; the proposal then generates complete paths and endpoint configurations, which are statistically corrected using the recorded non-equilibrium work. This dimensionless generalized work is determined by the probability ratio between the forward proposal path and a reverse reference path. translated_title: 神经非平衡哈密顿蒙特卡洛方法用于修正的玻尔兹曼采样
translated_abstract: 从未归一化的玻尔兹曼密度进行采样需要提出能够全局移动概率质量，同时保留足够的路径概率信息以进行统计修正的提议。我们引入了神经非平衡哈密顿蒙特卡洛（NHMC），一种先训练后修正的学习型哈密顿采样器。从可处理的基分布出发，NHMC学习朝向目标的随机哈密顿风格路径。训练完成后，学习到的提议参数被固定；提议随后生成完整路径和端点配置，这些配置使用记录的非平衡功进行统计修正。这个无量纲的广义功由前向提议路径与反向参考路径之间的概率比决定。在训练过程中，最小化其均值减少了路径空间KL散度，并控制了端点不匹配的上界。在评估过程中，相同的量定义了用于修正的权重。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的神经非平衡哈密顿蒙特卡洛采样方法，通过训练学习哈密顿路径并利用非平衡功进行统计修正，有效解决了从未归一化玻尔兹曼密度采样的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel Neural Non-Equilibrium Hamiltonian Monte Carlo sampling method that learns Hamiltonian paths and uses non-equilibrium work for statistical correction, effectively addressing the challenge of sampling from unnormalized Boltzmann densities.
